_note: Copy to plan.json once the clips are recorded. Pieces play in order; from/to are seconds in the clip (cut at pauses: studio pauses voiceover/*.m4a); each starts at its take (and segment) plus offset, or after the previous piece.

pieces.text: This is a sample project, recorded without a screen.
A terminal take opens VS Code on a folder, types each command,
and zooms in on the answer.
A web take moves a drawn cursor, scrolls, and marks what to look at.
